claims.statement: spine-check accepts a conformant repository and rejects a failing claim, a vacuous claim, a `true`-backed claim, and an ADR with no Verification section.
A verify command containing shell metacharacters fails instead of being reinterpreted by a shell.
ADR-0002 records why the spine rests, with jev's scores and the standing rule that produced them.
A clean build produces a wheel that installs into an empty environment and whose spine-check rejects a broken repository while accepting a conformant one.
